items.title: Google Skillshop digital skills
items.summary: Google offers free Google Ads training on Skillshop. The linked Fundamentals of Digital Marketing course covers beginner digital marketing; check its current terms.
items.bestFor: Beginners, jobseekers and small business owners
requirements: Sign in to track completion. Fundamentals is listed as a self-paced, 40-hour beginner course.
items.watchOut: Fundamentals now issues a digital award rather than the old Digital Garage certificate. Confirm the selected course cost; not every Google training programme is free.

items.title: Microsoft Learn South Africa
items.summary: Free Microsoft Learn training content, with module badges and learning-path trophies distinct from assessed credentials.
items.bestFor: Students, IT beginners and people building technical skills
requirements: A Learn profile saves progress. Check each module for prerequisites, software and subscription needs.
items.watchOut: Former Learn sandboxes are no longer available. Azure exercises can require a subscription and incur usage costs; certification exams can cost extra.

items.title: Vodacom Digital Skills Hub
items.summary: Free digital-skills courses, with some learning routes promoted as zero-rated for Vodacom users.
items.bestFor: Young people and jobseekers looking for digital skills
requirements: Registration is usually required; data benefits may depend on network and current programme rules.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current course catalogue and any zero-rated data wording on Vodacom's own page.

items.title: Book Dash
items.summary: Free African children's picture books that can be read, downloaded, printed and shared under an open model.
items.bestFor: Parents, teachers, libraries and reading clubs
requirements: No purchase needed for digital books; printing or data may still have normal user costs.
items.watchOut: Use the official Book Dash library rather than third-party download mirrors.

items.title: Nal'ibali
items.summary: Free stories, audio stories, printables and reading resources in South African languages.
items.bestFor: Families, teachers and caregivers of children aged 0-12
requirements: No purchase needed for online resources; downloads and printing may use data or paper.
items.watchOut: Choose the language and age level that fits the child instead of downloading random PDFs.

items.title: FunDza
items.summary: Mobile-friendly South African stories, reading content and literacy resources.
items.bestFor: Teens, young adults and mobile readers
requirements: Works best online or on mobile; account features may vary by current platform setup.
items.watchOut: It is stronger for teen and young-adult reading than preschool picture books.

items.title: Experian South Africa
items.summary: Free access to Experian personal credit report and credit score through Experian's consumer platform.
items.bestFor: Consumers checking their credit report and score
requirements: Valid South African ID details and identity verification are expected.
items.watchOut: Use Experian's official site and never share banking passwords or card PINs.

items.title: TransUnion South Africa
items.summary: Free annual credit report access from TransUnion South Africa.
items.bestFor: Consumers using their free annual bureau report right
requirements: Identity verification is required before report access.
items.watchOut: A free credit report is not the same as guaranteed credit approval.

items.title: ClearScore South Africa
items.summary: Free credit score and report access, with personalised financial offers shown separately.
items.bestFor: Consumers who want ongoing score and report visibility
requirements: Sign-up and identity checks are required.
items.watchOut: Treat loan and credit offers as advertising or eligibility guidance, not approval.

items.title: National Consumer Commission complaints portal
items.summary: Official National Consumer Commission information and complaint route for eligible consumer complaints.
items.bestFor: Consumers who need an official complaint route under the Consumer Protection Act
requirements: A registered e-Services profile, complaint details and supporting proof may be required.
items.watchOut: This is not a giveaway. Use it for consumer-rights support and keep copies of complaint references and evidence.

items.title: Free basic municipal services
items.summary: Government guidance on free basic water, electricity, sanitation or other municipal support for qualifying households.
items.bestFor: Low-income households checking whether they qualify for municipal indigent support
requirements: Usually means-tested through the local municipality; extra usage can still be billed.
items.watchOut: Rules differ by municipality, so confirm eligibility, documents and limits with your own local municipality.

items.title: Spur R50 birthday voucher
items.summary: A registered member who spent at least R1,000 at Spur in the 12 months before their birthday receives a R50 birthday voucher in their profile on the birthday.
items.bestFor: Registered Spur Family members who already spend regularly at Spur
requirements: Register a Spur Family profile in the app and reach R1,000 cumulative qualifying Spur spend during the 12 months before the birthday.
items.watchOut: This is a spend-linked loyalty voucher, not a no-purchase freebie. It is valid for 31 days, is non-transferable and can only be used by the registered member under the current redemption rules.

items.title: Bootlegger app registration coffee
items.summary: Bootlegger's official loyalty-app guide states that new users receive a free coffee on registration.
items.bestFor: New Bootlegger Coffee Company app users near a participating cafe
requirements: Download the Bootlegger app, create a new account and redeem the registration reward under the current in-app conditions.
items.watchOut: Check the reward's product choice, validity period and participating cafe availability in the app before travelling. The separate stamp reward requires ten purchases.

items.title: OpenLearn free courses and participation statements
items.provider: OpenLearn free courses and participation statements
items.summary: Free Open University learning content and courses. Completing a course can earn a free Statement of Participation; selected courses also offer a free digital badge.
items.bestFor: Independent learners exploring new subjects and practical skills
requirements: Reading content does not require an account. A free account requires age 13+; enrol and complete the course pages and required quizzes to receive a statement or available badge.
items.watchOut: Statements and badges carry no formal qualification credit. OpenLearn does not grant an Open University qualification, student status or student discounts. Internet and device costs remain yours.

items.title: IBM SkillsBuild free learning for adults
items.provider: IBM SkillsBuild free learning for adults
items.summary: IBM SkillsBuild offers free online adult learning. Selected learning activities award IBM digital credentials after their requirements are completed.
items.bestFor: Adults building technology and workplace skills for a career change or job search
requirements: The adult programme is for learners aged 18+. Create a free SkillsBuild account. Accepting and managing digital credentials requires a Credly account and the relevant completion requirements.
items.watchOut: Check each activity audience: some credentials and advanced routes are restricted to learners working with a partner non-profit organisation. A digital credential does not guarantee a job. Internet and device costs remain yours.

items.title: Canva Education for eligible school educators
items.provider: Canva Education for eligible school educators
items.summary: Canva Education is free worldwide for eligible K-12 teachers and institutions, including qualifying school librarians, learning support staff and curriculum specialists.
items.bestFor: Active, eligible primary and secondary school educators and accredited schools
requirements: You must currently hold an eligible certified role at a formally accredited primary or secondary school, or apply through a qualifying institution. Verify with an accepted educational email domain or supporting documents; re-verification is required every three years.
items.watchOut: Eligibility excludes universities and their students, private tutors, parents applying only as parents, inactive teachers and unlicensed homeschool educators. This is conditional education access; normal internet and device costs apply.

items.title: LearnFree practical skills lessons
items.summary: Free, self-paced lessons and practical learning content across computing, office tools, core skills and job seeking.
items.bestFor: Beginners learning computer, office, internet and job-search skills
requirements: Use a compatible device and internet connection. Provider terms require age 18+, emancipation, or express parent or guardian permission. Registered users under 18 need parent or guardian consent; certain features require an account.
items.watchOut: This listing covers free learning content and makes no promise of an accredited qualification or free certificate. Internet and device costs remain yours; follow the provider terms for account use.

items.title: MomConnect pregnancy and baby information
items.summary: The Department of Health provides pregnancy and baby-care information through MomConnect messaging, with a helpdesk and clinic-feedback service. The official USSD registration route is free.
items.bestFor: Pregnant women and mothers using South African public-clinic maternity services
requirements: Dial *134*550*2# for free USSD registration, or send join on WhatsApp to 079 631 2456. To finish registration, obtain the public-clinic facility code from a nurse and provide your estimated delivery date through the official service.
items.watchOut: WhatsApp can use mobile data; the official page does not promise zero-rated WhatsApp. This is an information service, with no promised physical samples. Share registration and health details only with the official service.

items.title: Johannesburg libraries: free basic membership
items.summary: The City's joining page offers free membership for borrowing four or fewer books at a time.
items.categoryLabel: Free family outings and public services
items.bestFor: Johannesburg residents who want basic library book borrowing
requirements: Apply at a City of Johannesburg library with an identity document and proof of residence; children also need a birth certificate. The joining page allows five working days for a first application to be processed. Use its official regional branch-directory links to find your library.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current lending allowance and membership category with your branch. Extra borrowing or services and overdue or lost items may incur charges; check current fees before using them. Branch opening hours and closure notices can change.

items.title: Durban Natural Science Museum: free City Hall galleries
items.provider: Durban Natural Science Museum: free City Hall galleries
items.summary: eThekwini Municipality lists free admission to the Natural Science Museum public galleries, first-floor City Hall cultural block, 234 Anton Lembede Street, Durban. No purchase, app, membership or citizenship requirement is stated for ordinary gallery admission.
items.categoryLabel: Free family outings and public services
items.bestFor: Durban visitors and local families looking for free public natural-history galleries
requirements: Visit the City Hall public galleries and check current opening arrangements before travelling. The municipal page lists visitor hours separately from general operating hours, so confirm the visitor timetable. Travel and optional purchases remain your responsibility.
items.watchOut: Do not touch displays unless interactive, disturb visitors, bring weapons or enter while intoxicated. Eating/drinking is limited to designated areas. Flash photography needs prior written consent; publishing photographs or videos also needs the director's prior written consent. The Kwa-Zuzulwazi Centre is temporarily closed and excluded. Research-collection visits have separate booking and permission conditions.

items.title: Iziko Museums: selected free days and eligible Fridays
items.provider: Iziko Museums: selected free days and eligible Fridays
items.summary: Selected Iziko museums offer free Friday admission for South African students and pensioners with valid identification. The official 2026 commemorative-day list also includes free entry at participating open sites on 1 December (Emancipation Day) and 16 December (Reconciliation Day).
items.categoryLabel: Free family outings and public services
items.bestFor: South African students and pensioners, and visitors planning a museum day in Cape Town
requirements: Present valid identification and, for student entry, a valid student card. Check the chosen museum's hours and eligibility before travelling; the South African Museum, National Gallery and Slave Lodge are examples of participating sites. Ordinary visitors pay the normal fee outside qualifying free days.
items.watchOut: This benefit excludes the Planetarium, Castle of Good Hope and Groot Constantia for the Friday and December dates described here. Closed sites and maintenance closures are excluded. Paid shows, guided tours and separately priced activities are not included. No account or purchase is stated for ordinary qualifying admission; travel and optional spending remain payable.

items.title: Panarottis Rewards: kids birthday meals, flatbread and hot drinks
items.summary: App members can claim a child birthday Kids Combo with a dining adult, a new-registration flatbread with R150 minimum spend, and one hot-drink voucher after ten qualifying purchases.
requirements: Ages 0–12, linked to an adult Rewards profile. Voucher arrives on birthday morning and lasts three months. Child and a dining adult must attend; on-premises Kids' Combo only. Adult dining costs remain payable; no adult minimum amount is stated. New app registrants receive a non-transferable flatbread voucher lasting three months. Redemption needs at least R150 spend; available for dine-in, call-and-collect or Click & Collect. Buy ten qualifying hot beverages to receive a three-month voucher for one free hot beverage. Redeem in South Africa for dine-in or call-and-collect; Click & Collect excluded. App/profile registration and transaction OTP required. Restaurant staff are excluded. Adults manage child profiles. Data and paid purchases/dining remain separate costs. The app is free to download. Adult account holders must be at least 18 and legally able to contract; parents/guardians consent for linked children. Kids membership ends automatically at 13. Each transaction OTP is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. Profiles and vouchers are non-transferable. Check the live app and August 2026 terms before ordering; qualifying criteria can change.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Earn 5% in Intercape loyalty points for future tickets
items.summary: Link a paid booking to your Intercape loyalty account to earn future-ticket points. Points become available after departure and expire after 12 months.
requirements: Earn 5% of qualifying ticket value after discounts and redeemed points, excluding taxes/third-party fees not retained by Intercape. Each point is R1 toward tickets, not cash. Identify the purchaser's loyalty account at purchase through Intercape's own app/site/office/contact centre. Points belong to purchaser rather than passenger, become available 24 hours after scheduled departure and expire 12 months later. Redemption is on Intercape's site/app, whole points only; disclosed availability/minimums can apply. Fully points-paid tickets earn no points. Paid travel and loyalty account required; ticket prices, standard travel/cancellation terms and connection costs apply. The inspected loyalty terms do not state a membership fee. Programme serves Intercape customers, including South African routes; no SA-citizenship restriction or minimum age stated in inspected loyalty terms. Official page dates programme start to 1 September 2025; no end date published. Marketing giveaway vouchers do not earn points. Registration allows processing of account details for loyalty administration and programme notices.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Earn 5% loyalty on purchases recorded in the vida app
items.summary: Register in the vida app and record purchases to earn points for a future order. In-store cash or card payments can earn loyalty without linking a bank card.
requirements: Current official app FAQ confirms 5% back on app-recorded transactions. Terms permit points toward part/full purchases in-app or in-store, with three-year expiry and no cash exchange. Register a profile; under-18s need guardian consent/supervision. In-store cash/card purchases can earn via the app, so linking a card is not necessary for that route; order-ahead requires linked-card payment. Paid purchases and internet-enabled app required. Current FAQ says no extra app-payment charge; normal product/banking/data costs remain. No delivery route promised. No fixed programme end date is stated. The current terms require accurate profile details and permit OTP, order, service, marketing and promotional messages. Order Ahead is for same-day collection from the selected store. Check points immediately after purchase.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Save 5% on Greyhound with Capitec Pay
items.summary: Capitec clients get 5% off a paid Greyhound booking on its own website or app on a mobile device when paying with Capitec Pay.
requirements: Capitec clients receive 5% off Greyhound tickets booked on the operator's website/app and paid with Capitec Pay. Current homepage restricts the discount to mobile-device payment and excludes payment by Capitec bank card. It applies automatically at checkout, cannot be added afterwards, and standard changes/cancellation/refund terms apply. Paid bus ticket and qualifying Capitec account/payment approval required. No coupon code. Banking/data costs remain separate; no universal discount for cash, other banks or card payments implied. Official article is dated 21 January 2026; current homepage still advertises the benefit. No fixed expiry; operator can amend/withdraw it.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Three months of Clue Plus with Virgin Active Rewards
items.summary: Eligible Virgin Active members aged 18+ can select three months of Clue Plus after reaching a rewards milestone. Payment details are required; it renews at the standard rate unless cancelled.
requirements: Active Virgin Active membership in South Africa, Botswana or Namibia, age 18+ and achievement of the app’s milestone goal are required. Select the Clue Plus reward in the Virgin Active app and activate it within seven days. It cannot overlap or extend an existing Clue subscription or trial. Valid payment details are required; there is no subscription charge during the initial three months, then automatic renewal at Clue’s standard rate unless cancelled beforehand under Clue’s terms. No fixed renewal price is stated here: check it before activation. This is a member subscription reward, not free gym membership. Availability and partner exclusions apply.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Seven days of extra DStv channels for qualifying monthly customers
items.summary: Eligible DStv Select and Sports monthly customers can receive seven days of higher-package channels after paying on time. A paid subscription and qualifying history are required; the extra viewing ends automatically without an upgrade charge.
requirements: South African residential DStv or DStv Stream monthly subscribers must have completed at least one full month, stay active on an eligible package and ensure full payment reaches MultiChoice before the next due date. Select receives Sport; Sports receives Premium. The seven-day benefit is automatic, linked to the next viewing cycle and may take up to 48 hours to provision. Viewing returns to the normal package afterwards without an extra upgrade fee. Business, quarterly/annual, Price Lock and Subscription Price Lock accounts, unpaired packages, add-ons and certain disconnected/inactive accounts are excluded. Reconnected customers qualify only in month two after two consecutive active months. Add-ons and value-added services keep their normal charges. The provider announces Starter-to-Select and Movies & Series-to-Premium from 26 October under a separate later package phase, not as already available on 21 October.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Invited Vodacom customers: 12 months Prime Video Mobile Edition
items.summary: Selected Vodacom customers receiving the official SMS can activate 12 months of Prime Video Mobile Edition. It automatically becomes a paid R29/month subscription deducted from airtime unless cancelled in time.
requirements: Invitation-only South African Vodacom reward, with notifications during 2 March–15 November 2026. Receive the official SMS, use its portal link and sign up; the 12 months start on activation. Correct RICA registration and valid SA ID/residence documentation are required. Sign in at least once every two months to keep the reward. Normal mobile data costs may remain. This is Mobile Edition, not an unrestricted promise of every Prime subscription benefit. At trial expiry it automatically changes to a paid R29 monthly subscription deducted from airtime unless cancelled. Manage subscriptions at the official Vodafone offers portal linked in Vodacom’s terms; cancellation is also available through Vodacom self-service, Customer Care 082135, *135#, VodaPay or the service’s cancellation menu. Porting/cancelling the number forfeits unused reward. No cash exchange or transfer.
items.watchOut: Confirm the current price, availability and terms with the provider before buying.

items.title: Up to three Lush samples with a paid online order
items.summary: Lush South Africa offers complimentary samples with paid online orders, subject to availability and exclusions. Choose up to three from the cart’s sample menu where available; sample-only postal requests are not offered.
requirements: A product purchase is required for online sample delivery, and normal order/delivery charges apply. Lush may select samples based on the order, or customers can select up to three through Add Samples in the cart. Samples are subject to availability, capped at three per customer, and exclude gifts, mouthcare and bath products. The FAQ says it cannot send samples without a product purchase. In-store staff may prepare a sample for trying a new product at home; repeat requests for the same product may be limited. In-store availability and selection are discretionary and no nationwide sample stock is promised. No fixed campaign expiry is published.
